# OpenProgram 0.6.4 Release Notes

Original version date: August 15, 2026. This tag fixed the principal complete-GUI-runtime dependency ranges, but the Desktop architecture argument was still mapped incorrectly. It did not publish installable assets.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Constrained NumPy, OpenCV, Torch, and related dependencies for the complete GUI runtime.
- Prevented incompatible runtime dependency combinations across platforms.

## ⚠️ Release status

- The Intel macOS runtime used `x86_64`, while the Desktop builder required `x64`; the architecture argument was not mapped correctly.
- No GitHub Release or installable runtime assets were published.
- This tag is not an installable user version; all fixes are included in `v0.6.6`.

## 🔄 Version guide

- Previous release attempt: [`v0.6.3`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.3)
